title: RASS NeRF Benchmark Artifact
subtitle: Risk-audited compact scene lists for NeRF benchmarking
description:
Artifact for the NeurIPS 2026 paper "RASS: Risk-Audited Budget Selection for Compact NeRF Benchmark Subsets" (AlMughrabi, Serret, Marques, Radeva).

It packages RASS-48 (Zip-NeRF-certified screening subset) and RASS-96 (recommended compact reporting subset), the Zip-NeRF audit scene list, cross-method common IDs, normalized descriptors, k=6 regime labels, audit thresholds, Wilson LCB utilities, Croissant/RAI metadata (croissant.json), and audit results.

Version 1.1.0 adds the review-period analyses: completed nerfacto and BioNeRF logs, DL3DV per-scene metrics for four methods, versioned audit-event configurations, the FL-36' reimplementation, and machine-readable results.

License: GPL-3.0, except DL3DV-derived files, which are CC BY-NC 4.0 (see rebuttal/method_logs/README.md). Raw Nutrition5k-derived assets and complete NeRF outputs are not redistributed.
